subject: twins
one_liner: Payment tools for twins who want separate identities until someone pays for matching outfits.
brand_voice_notes: Applied pipelines/codex-v1/skills/anti-ai-slop/SKILL.md and the local humor calibration. Write with the calm precision of a payments company documenting an unfortunate success. Adult twins are willing participants whose wish for independence meets an attractive payment. Keep controls plain, introduce payment mechanics through actions, and let customer choices supply the embarrassment. Use the worst AI studio ever as a small maker credit. All product prices are fictional.
demo_screen_concept: A merchant dashboard for Nina and Leah Patel, with Products, Payments, Subscriptions and Payouts navigation. The main workflow creates a payment link for a joint appearance, previews the customer checkout and simulates a payment. Their product list includes Nina's violin lessons, Leah's electrical visits and their bestselling joint appearance, described as 'Stand next to each other.' Choose the $120 appearance, inspect the checkout and select Simulate payment. The resulting record shows the processing fee and equal net payouts to their separate bank accounts. Supporting panels reveal Mum's active matching-outfit subscription and a payment for Nina's solo violin performance that also paid Leah. A persistent Sample account label makes the simulation clear.

hero.h1: Mum's paying. You're both in sailor suits.
hero.sub: Tandem lets twins sell joint appearances, take monthly payments for matching outfits and split their earnings. You spent twenty years asking to be treated as individuals. Mum has subscribed.

features.title: Sell a joint appearance.
features.blurb: Create payment links for violin lessons, electrical repairs and a joint appearance. You trained for years; your twin runs a business. Your bestseller is 'Stand next to each other.'

features.title: Take recurring payments.
features.blurb: Let a customer pay monthly to choose both your outfits. Mum signs up with a saved card. At 32, you're back in matching sailor collars, waiting for her payment to clear.

features.title: Split every payment equally.
features.blurb: Connect both bank accounts and divide the earnings automatically. Your first solo speaking fee sends half to your twin, who stayed home. He's begun calling your solo career 'our business.'

candidates.premise: Adult twins use payment tools to make childhood fairness exact.
candidates.audience_behavior: They still compare the value of birthday presents and notice who received slightly more.
candidates.source_mechanic: Separate checkout line items, partial refunds and split payouts assign a value to each half of a shared celebration.
candidates.comic_turn: A shared birthday cake becomes two separately purchased slices while the twins argue over which one contains the larger strawberry.

candidates.premise: Twins turn mistaken identity into a purchase-dispute strategy.
candidates.audience_behavior: They enjoy being mistaken for each other when it gets them out of trouble.
candidates.source_mechanic: A disputed card payment opens an evidence timeline containing checkout details, delivery photographs and customer messages.
candidates.comic_turn: The twin who says 'That was my brother' has to teach the merchant how to tell them apart, supplying the distinction he normally refuses to explain.

candidates.premise: Twins sell their resemblance and discover that customers pay to erase their differences.
candidates.audience_behavior: They want individual recognition but are tempted to earn something from the double act strangers already expect.
candidates.source_mechanic: Payment links sell joint appearances, subscriptions renew matching-outfit requests and connected accounts divide earnings automatically.
candidates.comic_turn: Separate careers become an optional extra while Mum acquires recurring control of their clothes and a stay-at-home twin earns from the other's solo work.

angle_selection.selected_premise: Twins sell their resemblance and discover that customers pay to erase their differences.
angle_selection.reason: The conflict between independence and easy money is clear without specialist knowledge. Checkout choices, recurring charges and split payouts produce three different consequences: professional skills go unused, childhood matching clothes return and solo success supports an absent sibling. The fairness premise risks becoming another billing joke; the dispute premise depends too heavily on an evidence process. Compared with the recent digest, this avoids collection growth, photographic deception, competitive visibility and rewards distracting someone from an event. Payments belong at the center because the selected source is Stripe; the jokes come from what twins agree to sell.

observations.behavior: Twins want their separate accomplishments recognized while hoping their resemblance might also earn money.
observations.mechanic: They publish payment links for their individual skills alongside a purchasable joint appearance.
observations.consequence: Customers consistently choose to look at them together. Years of training become less commercially useful than standing still beside a sibling.
observations.landing_callback: The first feature makes 'Stand next to each other' the bestseller. Nina's testimonial moves the paid double act into strangers' wedding memories, where the twins occupy the album despite having no personal connection to the couple.
observations.demo_callback: The product list places violin lessons and electrical visits beside the bestselling appearance. Its checkout asks for an event location and two standing positions, giving the twins marks on the floor instead of work for their respective skills.

observations.behavior: Twins preserve equal treatment even after their effort and careers diverge.
observations.mechanic: Connected bank accounts automatically receive equal shares of net earnings, with the same rule applied to individual bookings.
observations.consequence: An absent twin becomes a financial beneficiary of the other's attempt to succeed alone and starts encouraging a more demanding solo schedule.
observations.landing_callback: The third feature turns a solo speaking career into 'our business.' Daniel's testimonial gives the speech an explicitly independent subject, then has the paid sibling suggest the next city.

source_product_patterns: A merchant dashboard separates Products, Payments, Subscriptions and Payouts.
A product has a description, price and payment link that opens a hosted customer checkout.
Checkout shows the selected product, amount due and card-payment form before confirmation.
Subscriptions display billing intervals, saved payment methods, renewal dates and customer requests.
Connected accounts receive configurable shares of net earnings through separate payouts.
Payment details distinguish the gross charge, processing fee and amounts sent to each account.
editorial_plan.composition_plan: Primary action: Create a payment link. Recognizable product visual: a merchant product list beside a hosted checkout preview and a two-account payout summary. Open with the Tandem identity, small studio credit, headline, short explanation and CTA. Place the working product preview immediately beneath the proposition, with the joint-appearance product selected so the audience and payment mechanism are visible together. Follow with three open feature passages, customer incidents and a joined fee comparison. Proposed artwork one is a formal studio portrait of adult twins in matching sailor outfits: one still holds a violin case and the other a work bag. Its purpose is to make the return to childhood matching visible while preserving evidence of separate adult lives. Proposed artwork two is a wedding contact sheet in which the same paid twins appear beside several members of an unfamiliar family. Its purpose is to show how a small appearance product inserts them into strangers' permanent memories. Product thumbnails use paired portraits; they identify purchasable appearances rather than decorate every section. Keep payment details, requests, names and testimonials in live text. On mobile, stack product selection, checkout preview and payout result in workflow order. Artwork follows the usable product preview.

references.reference: Twins Days festival portraits of adult twins in coordinated outfits
references.cues: Full-length paired poses, deliberate outfit coordination, direct eye contact and small personal differences visible within an apparently identical pair.
references.application: Photograph fictional adult twins at equal scale against one backdrop. Preserve differences in posture, accessories and expressions so the images show two people willingly selling a matched appearance.

references.reference: Department-store sibling portrait packages and printed proof sheets
references.cues: Soft portrait-blue backgrounds, warm white order paper, numbered image proofs, formal poses and packages that repeatedly sell the same family pairing.
references.application: Use portrait-blue image fields, thin proof-sheet divisions and small image numbers. Adapt the ordering hierarchy to product photographs and prices without copying a retailer's branding.

audience_design.landing_application: Use a coherent adult portrait-package identity: portrait blue #AAC9DA, warm white #FAF7F0, cherry #A32743 for actions and charcoal #242629 for text. Set expressive headlines in Bodoni Moda and readable explanations and controls in DM Sans. Pair broad portrait fields with open text passages; reserve proof-sheet grids for photographs and product evidence. The opening gives the proposition and merchant preview priority. Use matching compositions to expose individual differences, with no split-screen animation or repeated decorative twin icons.
audience_design.demo_application: Retain the source service's merchant navigation, product rows, payment-link editor, checkout order summary and transaction detail hierarchy. Apply the same portrait-blue thumbnails, cherry selected states, warm white surfaces and DM Sans controls at higher information density. Bodoni Moda appears only in the small product identity and customer-facing checkout heading. Each twin has a separate named account and portrait; payout rows make their equal shares legible. Proof-sheet numbering connects products to photographs while ordinary tables, forms and buttons keep the payment workflow familiar.

design_direction.archetype: Product-led payments landing with portrait-package imagery: proposition above merchant product list and hosted checkout; open feature passages; two composed campaign spreads; customer incidents and joined fee comparison.
design_direction.motion_vocab: 150ms color feedback; deliberate tab changes and checkout confirmation; no ambient animation; reduced-motion removes transitions.
design_direction.hero_composition_notes: Broad headline and explanation across opening row. Merchant list, selected portrait and hosted checkout immediately below. Mobile stacks proposition, products, checkout and payout summary. Artwork follows recognizable product evidence.
design_direction.design_review: Compared supplied seven-entry digest. No matching style/palette/font tuple. Paired oval portrait windows and proof-envelope geometry differ from chair pennant, bridge chair, poultry rosette, rail turnout, yearbook cursor, cupboard and salvage tags. Library dashboard density and luxury Bodoni hierarchy retained; generic particles, Fira dashboard type and pink/black palette rejected in favor of approved audience references.

brand_kit.identity_rationale: Adult sibling portrait-package identity: two adjacent tall oval portrait windows with subtly differing internal profiles and a joined baseline. The mark makes pairing a sellable portrait package, rather than duplicating initials or copying Stripe. Bespoke Tandem lettering and cherry proofs distinguish this from recent entries.

items.prompt: Design a finished original logo on a perfectly flat pure white background, no mockup, no board, no shadows. Exact wordmark: Tandem. Adult twins sell their resemblance through payment links; identity from department-store sibling portrait packages. Direction A: bespoke elegant readable Bodoni-inspired serif lettering in cherry #A32743. To its LEFT a standalone small original symbol: two adjacent tall oval portrait windows containing two subtly different abstract adult profiles, joined on one baseline. Keep symbol distinct and simple at 32px. NOT a generic geometric badge, not initials, not Stripe trademark. Horizontal wide lockup with generous spacing around mark and letters. Only cherry and white, no other text. Correct spelling T a n d e m. Refined professional identity, calm rather than childish.
items.verdict: A accepted after visual comparison. Correct spelling, clear letter spacing and paired profiles; extracted white ground to real alpha and normalized cherry. B rejected.

items.transformation: Faithful charcoal recolor of accepted alpha mask
